trailhead.name: Shake Camp Trailhead (Long Meadow Trail 31E15, Mountain Home State Forest)

identifiedBy.fact: 2019-era trip report parks near Shake Camp, drops to and crosses a Tule River fork, goes up west slopes to Pt 10,113 and the saddle to North Maggie; USFS says Long Meadow Trail begins at Shake Camp (about 6,800 ft)

placements.source: climber.org driving GPX (SHAKEC Shake Camp Trailhead)
placements.name: Shake Camp Trailhead

otherFacts.value: drainage NW of summit between North Maggie and Pt 10,113

notes: Opened: themtsarecalling.com/maggie (starts Shake Camp, matches route text: Tule River crossing, Pt 10,113 saddle; its header oddly lists Balch Park but narrative is Shake Camp); USFS Long Meadow Trail page (begins at Shake Camp, no coordinate). Placements not land-manager; carried from earlier pass.

trailhead.name: Indian Wells Canyon wilderness-boundary trailhead (barricade, end of Indian Wells Canyon Road SE152)

identifiedBy.fact: Sierra Club Hundred Peaks guide: park at barricaded wilderness boundary about 5,440 ft, 7.7 mi up dirt road from SR 14, hike old road past barricade to clearing at 6,100 ft, right fork; 7 mi RT, 3,200 ft gain - matches the route text exactly

placements.source: Sierra Club Hundred Peaks guide (printed trailhead link)
placements.name: Indian Wells Canyon barricade trailhead

notes: Opened hundredpeaks.org guide 01h (only route listed, Indian Wells approach, no formal trailhead name). Coordinate is from a non-land-manager page (Sierra Club); one placement. Search summary also mentioned Powers Well 2.7 mi up road (not opened, other blog) - differs from 7.7 mi figure; trust the guide.

identifiedBy.fact: 2021 trip report climbs Pettit by traverse from Volunteer Peak, starting at Virginia Lakes TH; class 2 gully to the north ridge. Burd's Tuolumne/Return Creek trip is described by him as exploratory, rarely done, one of the hardest SPS approaches - not the usual

otherFacts.value: Tuolumne Meadows, Glen Aulin, Return Creek, ~4,500 ft gain from creek, 18 hr

notes: Moderate/weak. Opened: wacziarg 2021 (Virginia Lakes), snwburd pettit_1 (Tuolumne, exploratory), hikingwalking Virginia Lakes (no Pettit mention), hometownlocator USFS point. Search summaries (not opened) say Pettit is almost always done via Volunteer traverse. Two starts exist; this call rests on Burd calling his the unusual one. No specific page labelled 'standard route'.

trailhead.name: Rocky Canyon pullout on US 50 (informal start, not a signed trailhead)

identifiedBy.fact: Rocky Canyon route starts at a roadside pullout on US 50 before Twin Bridges; trail up a dirt bank across the road

notes: Nothing new opened beyond earlier pages; search summaries (komoot, fatmap, not opened) agree on a US 50 shoulder pullout. Not land-manager placements. Pyramid Creek TH is a different route.

trailhead.name: Bear Ridge Trailhead (Lake Thomas Edison dam vista point)

identifiedBy.fact: Two trip reports (Burd, themtsarecalling) start at Bear Ridge TH near the Lake Edison diversion dam, 5 mi Bear Ridge Trail to JMT/PCT junction, then cross-country to SW ridge; 17.2 mi RT, 7,900 ft gain

notes: Opened themtsarecalling.com/recess (Bear Ridge TH). Wacziarg 2023 Gabb/Recess trip started at Mosquito Flat over Mono Pass (seen in search summary only, not opened) - a multi-peak backpack, not the normal start. USFS point is a trail point, approximate for the dam-overlook trailhead. Single placement.

trailhead.name: Sawtooth Trailhead, Mineral King (Sawtooth Pass climber's trail)

identifiedBy.fact: Three opened pages start at Mineral King and walk Sawtooth Pass, Little Five Lakes, Big Arroyo (camp ~11,500 ft) then up the broad chutes of the west side: climber.org 2008 report, Burd report, Alpine Institute Kaweah Traverse (Glacier and Hands and Knees Passes)

otherFacts.value: Big Arroyo 11,500 ft, ~4.4 mi past Little Five Lakes
3.6 mi, 2,100 ft gain from high camp

notes: Stronger than before: three opened pages, all Mineral King. Crescent Meadow/High Sierra Trail is a possible alternative but no opened page uses it for Red Kaweah. Sawtooth vs Eagle-Mosquito/Farewell Gap lots are neighbouring Mineral King lots; the Sawtooth Pass climber's trail leaves from the Sawtooth/Monarch Creek lot.

Opened snwburd rodgers_1: starts Rush Creek TH near Silver Lake (June Lake), Agnew Lake, Gem, Waugh, Marie Lakes, NE ridge, ~5 hr trail approach. Earlier opened climber.org 2006/1567 started at Agnew Meadows. Tuolumne/Lyell Canyon via Marie Lakes also exists (search summary only). Three starts, nothing ties 'Standard route' to one. Candidates: Rush Creek TH (no official candidate in list), Agnew Meadows (USFS Shadow Lake TH 37.682096,-119.08618), Tuolumne Meadows.

trailhead.name: North Big Meadow (Sirretta) Trailhead, Kern Plateau, Forest Road 23S07

identifiedBy.fact: USFS: Sirretta Peak Trail 34E12 starts at the north end of Big Meadow, north on Cannell Trail ~0.5 mi then northeast, ~3 mi more; trip report parks free on FR 23S07; 7.5 mi RT, 2,300 ft gain

placements.source: climber.org driving page GPX (SIRETH Sirretta trailhead 7800)
placements.name: Sirretta trailhead

otherFacts.value: Sirretta Peak Trail 34E12, ~3 mi from Cannell junction

notes: Now a land-manager page (USFS trail page) ties the peak to the Big Meadow north end; no coordinate printed there. USFS Big Meadows Trailhead page (36.718,-118.833) is Jennie Lakes, a different place - do not use. Placement still the earlier climber.org GPX, single.
